name: Lukan AI Agent, IDE and Workstation
description: Open-source AI workstation that runs on top of your operating system to complete real end-to-end work. Includes an integrated coding agent (built in Rust), tmux-based persistent terminals, multi-agent parallel execution, and agentic pipelines with approval workflows. Features OpenClaw-style channel support for WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack control and persistent session memory across agent interactions.
community_quotes: The pipeline approvals layer is blocking per-agent but async globally - one waiting agent doesn't block others
Per-step tool access is underappreciated. Most frameworks give the whole pipeline the same permissions
Persistent memory between sessions - agent barely needs reminding of context anymore because of how he built session memory into it
The tmux-based terminals and multi-agent monitoring in a single pane sounds like a demo gimmick until you see it running
